summary: Ho everyone who thirsts come to waters and he who has no money come buy eat yes come buy wine and milk without money without price. Why spend money for that which is not bread labor for that which doesn't satisfy? Listen diligently to me eat what is good let soul delight itself in fatness. Incline ear come to me hear and soul shall live and I will make everlasting covenant with you even sure mercies of David. Behold I have given him for witness to peoples leader commander to peoples. Behold you shall call nation you don't know and nation that didn't know you shall run to you because of Yahweh and Holy One of Israel for he has glorified you. Seek Yahweh while he may be found call while he is near let wicked forsake way and unrighteous man his thoughts let him return to Yahweh and he will have mercy and to our God for he will abundantly pardon. For my thoughts not your thoughts nor your ways my ways says Yahweh, for as heavens higher than earth so are my ways higher than your ways and my thoughts than your thoughts. For as rain and snow come down from sky and return not thither but water earth make it bring forth and bud give seed to sower and bread to eater so shall my word be that goes forth out of my mouth it shall not return void but shall accomplish that which I please and shall prosper in thing whereto I sent it. For you shall go out with joy and be led forth with peace mountains and hills break forth before you into singing and all trees of field clap hands, instead of thorn shall come up cypress instead of brier myrtle and it shall be to Yahweh for a name for everlasting sign not cut off.
whyItMatters: Great invitation — everyone thirsty come to waters without money, everlasting covenant sure mercies of David, seek Yahweh while may be found, my thoughts not your thoughts higher, word shall not return void, mountains sing trees clap hands transformation thorn to cypress.

keyVerses.text: “Hey! Come, everyone who thirsts, to the waters! Come, he who has no money, buy, and eat! Yes, come, buy wine and milk without money and without price.
keyVerses.why: Ho everyone who thirsts come to waters no money — free invitation.

keyVerses.text: “For my thoughts are not your thoughts, and your ways are not my ways,” says Yahweh.
keyVerses.why: My thoughts not your thoughts higher — transcendence.

keyVerses.text: so is my word that goes out of my mouth: it will not return to me void, but it will accomplish that which I please, and it will prosper in the thing I sent it to do.
keyVerses.why: Word not return void — effective word accomplishes purpose.

questions.question: What does 'everyone who thirsts come to waters he who has no money come buy eat without money without price' mean?
questions.answer: Invitation Ho! Everyone thirsty (tsame — thirsty for water and metaphorical) come to waters and he who has no money come buy and eat wine and milk without money without price. Wine and milk are luxury and staple — free feast. Why spend money for not bread and labor for not satisfy? Listen eat what good let soul delight in fatness (rich food). Incline ear come hear soul live and I will make everlasting covenant with you even sure mercies of David (chesed David fulfilled). Witness leader commander to peoples, you shall call nation you don't know and nation didn't know you shall run to you because Yahweh glorified you — Gentiles included. For zero-background: salvation as free feast for thirsty with no money, not purchase but gift.

questions.question: What does 'seek Yahweh while may be found call while near let wicked forsake way and thoughts return he will have mercy abundantly pardon' mean?
questions.answer: Seek while may be found call while he is near — there is window of opportunity, nearness now. Wicked forsake way (derek) and unrighteous man his thoughts (machashavot) let him return (shuv — turn) to Yahweh and he will have mercy and to our God for he will abundantly pardon (rabeh salach — multiply pardon). For my thoughts not your thoughts nor your ways my ways says Yahweh, for as heavens higher than earth so higher my ways thoughts than yours — God's mercy higher than human calculation of revenge. Some think God wouldn't forgive them, but his thoughts higher, mercy more abundant than expected.

questions.question: What does 'as rain snow from sky water earth give seed bread so shall my word not return void' and mountains sing trees clap mean?
questions.answer: Rain and snow come down from sky return not thither but water earth make bring forth bud give seed to sower and bread to eater — natural cycle water. So shall my word that goes out of mouth not return void but accomplish that which I please and prosper whereto sent — effective word, like rain does not return to sky without watering. For you shall go out with joy be led with peace mountains and hills break forth singing and all trees clap hands — creation personified rejoicing at exodus-like deliverance. Instead of thorn cypress, brier myrtle — transformation of cursed ground (thorns from Genesis 3) to fruitful trees, everlasting sign not cut off. Word accomplishes new creation and joyful return.

glossary.def: Free feast — wine milk without price, grace gift not purchase.
My thoughts higher than yours — mercy higher than human revenge calculation.
Dabar that goes out accomplishes purpose like rain watering, not empty.
